entries.title: Proverbs 24:1
segments: ¶Be not thou envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:2
segments: For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:3
segments: ¶Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established:

entries.title: Proverbs 24:4
segments: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:5
segments: A wise man [is] strong; yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength. {is strong: Heb. is in strength} {increaseth...: Heb. strengtheneth might}

words.text: . {is strong: Heb. is in strength} {increaseth...: Heb. strengtheneth might}

entries.title: Proverbs 24:6
segments: For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: and in multitude of counsellors [there is] safety.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:7
segments: ¶Wisdom [is] too high for a fool: he openeth not his mouth in the gate.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:8
segments: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:9
segments: The thought of foolishness [is] sin: and the scorner [is] an abomination to men.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:10
segments: ¶[If] thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength [is] small. {small: Heb. narrow}

entries.title: Proverbs 24:11
segments: ¶If thou forbear to deliver [them that are] drawn unto death, and [those that are] ready to be slain;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:12
segments: If thou sayest, Behold, we knew it not; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider [it]? and he that keepeth thy soul, doth [not] he know [it]? and shall [not] he render to [every] man according to his works?

words.text: it not; doth not he that pondereth

entries.title: Proverbs 24:13
segments: ¶My son, eat thou honey, because [it is] good; and the honeycomb, [which is] sweet to thy taste: {to...: Heb. upon thy palate}

entries.title: Proverbs 24:14
segments: So [shall] the knowledge of wisdom [be] unto thy soul: when thou hast found [it], then there shall be a reward, and thy expectation shall not be cut off.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:15
segments: ¶Lay not wait, O wicked [man], against the dwelling of the righteous; spoil not his resting place:

entries.title: Proverbs 24:16
segments: For a just [man] falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:17
segments: ¶Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, and let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth:

entries.title: Proverbs 24:18
segments: Lest the LORD see [it], and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him. {it displeaseth...: Heb. it be evil in his eyes}

words.text: from him. {it displeaseth...: Heb. it be evil in his eyes}

entries.title: Proverbs 24:19
segments: ¶Fret not thyself because of evil [men], neither be thou envious at the wicked; {Fret...: or, Keep not company with the wicked}

words.text: ; {Fret...: or, Keep not company with the wicked}

entries.title: Proverbs 24:20
segments: For there shall be no reward to the evil [man]; the candle of the wicked shall be put out. {candle: or, lamp}

words.text: For there shall be no reward

entries.title: Proverbs 24:21
segments: ¶My son, fear thou the LORD and the king: [and] meddle not with them that are given to change: {them...: Heb. changers}

words.text: not with them that are given to change

entries.title: Proverbs 24:22
segments: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin of them both?

entries.title: Proverbs 24:23
segments: ¶These [things] also [belong] to the wise. [It is] not good to have respect of persons in judgment.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:24
segments: He that saith unto the wicked, Thou [art] righteous; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him:

entries.title: Proverbs 24:25
segments: But to them that rebuke [him] shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them. {a good...: Heb. a blessing of good}

words.text: upon them. {a good...: Heb. a blessing of good}

entries.title: Proverbs 24:26
segments: [Every man] shall kiss [his] lips that giveth a right answer. {that...: Heb. that answereth right words}

entries.title: Proverbs 24:27
segments: ¶Prepare thy work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thine house.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:28
segments: ¶Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause; and deceive [not] with thy lips.

entries.title: Proverbs 24:29
segments: Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me: I will render to the man according to his work.

words.text: so to him as he hath done

entries.title: Proverbs 24:30
segments: ¶I went by the field of the slothful, and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;

entries.title: Proverbs 24:31
segments: And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, [and] nettles had covered the face thereof, and the stone wall thereof was broken down.

words.text: And, lo, it was all grown over

entries.title: Proverbs 24:32
segments: Then I saw, [and] considered [it] well: I looked upon [it, and] received instruction. {considered...: Heb. set my heart}

entries.title: Proverbs 24:33
segments: [Yet] a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:

entries.title: Proverbs 24:34
segments: So shall thy poverty come [as] one that travelleth; and thy want as an armed man. {an...: Heb. a man of shield}
